subject: Freight tracking - who schedules my delivery?
body: I'm trying to track my freight shipment of the half rack and figure out delivery. An old FAQ/PDF I found said I have to call the carrier and schedule it all myself. Is that right, or do you handle it? Tracking PRO 553-9087.
note: Archived ARCH-01 says self-service; Active SOP-02 says we coordinate. Must follow SOP-02 and FLAG the conflict.
